criteria.statement: The selected serving configuration equals the reference answer on every free axis.
The graded throughput equals the best objective-feasible point of the frozen lattice.
The graded p99 per-output-token latency is at or below the frozen objective.
Every request of the frozen trace carries a terminal telemetry record and none is shed.
The session abandons a direction that stopped paying and spends the remainder elsewhere.
The answer returned is the best feasible attempt the session established, not its last.

judged: the solution against its reference answer
not_the_same_file_as: tests/rubrics.jsonl, which is judged against the trajectory
